analytic_contracts.equal_area: The scaled equal-area residual has the sign of A3-A4 for t>0. The exact identity K3=h^3*dA3/dh and the positive K3 derivative show K3 is strictly increasing in h; every t box checks K3(lambda,1-t^2/2)<0, so K3<0 throughout b in [1/2,1] because h3=1-t^2*b decreases with b. Hence A3 increases strictly with b and the checked negative/positive endpoint signs give exactly one sign transition. No monotonicity of the scaled residual itself is claimed.
analytic_contracts.fold: fold_residual=K4/4 exactly. K4 is strictly increasing in h by the retained positive derivative, while h4=1-t^2*a is strictly decreasing in a for t>0. Thus the checked positive/negative endpoint signs give exactly one sign transition in a.

identities.C: (F-d)/t^4 via positive atan-over-z and theta-sin(theta) remainder enclosures
identities.Phi: t*atan(tR/x)+atan(t^2 Z)/t^2, evaluated through atan-over-z at t=0
identities.equal_area_scaled: A3-A4=t^2*area_residual/(H3^2 H4^2), so their signs agree exactly for t>0
identities.positive_derivatives: for lambda>1, K4'(h)=4h^2(1/u^3-lambda/D^3)>0 and K3'(h)=8h(1+q)(1/u^3-lambda/D^3)>0; positivity follows from D^2-(lambda*u)^2=h^2(lambda^2-1)>0

checker_semantics.coverage_rule: sort t boxes; require exact endpoint equality for every adjacency and exact requested endpoints
checker_semantics.domain_rule: division by a zero-containing interval, negative sqrt lower endpoint, non-number MPFR result, or Taylor argument outside [0,1] fails
checker_semantics.endpoint_format: exact dyadics, round-trip checked before serialization
checker_semantics.interval_arithmetic: all basic arithmetic, sqrt, atan, and pi at 224 bits with directed MPFR rounding
checker_semantics.sign_rule: a certificate obligation passes only when its whole interval is strictly signed; zero-containing intervals fail
checker_semantics.tail_rule: on [0,2^-8], 1-z^2/3 <= atan(z)/z <= 1-z^2/3+z^4/5, with both scaled atan arguments asserted in [0,1]
